# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] <project-slug>: <Short Project Title>`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/<project-slug>/`

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** AI-Powered Recipe & Ingredient Waste Optimizer
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** An intelligent household pantry optimizer and recipe generator powered by IBM Db2 and LangChain that minimizes domestic food waste through expiry-aware deterministic ranking and grounded cooking instructions.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Solves household food spoilage and leftover waste for busy families and home cooks by tracking perishables, predicting expiry urgency, and recommending recipes that maximize in-stock ingredient consumption.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** WasteNot AI
- **Team Members:**

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| ashfin prem | @ashfinashfi | ashfin96a@gmail.com / Full Stack & AI Engineer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 Community Edition (v12.1.0500 on Linux x86_64 via Docker)
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** IBM Db2 serves as the primary transactional database and semantic store: holding master ingredients, household pantry inventory, structured recipe catalogues, 384-dimensional dense recipe embeddings, cooking history, and an append-only audit event ledger (`INVENTORY_EVENTS`).
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Native `ibm_db` (v3.3.0) and SQLAlchemy integration (`ibm_db_sa`). Automated Windows DLL registration for `clidriver/bin` and `AUTHENTICATION=SERVER` negotiation.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** `INGREDIENTS`, `USER_INVENTORY`, `RECIPES`, `RECIPE_INGREDIENTS`, `RECIPE_EMBEDDINGS`, `COOKING_HISTORY`, `INVENTORY_EVENTS`.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:**
  1. `docker compose -f submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/docker-compose.yml up -d`
  2. `python submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/scripts/init_db.py --drop`
  3. `python submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/scripts/seed_recipes.py`
  4. `python submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/scripts/demo_seed.py`
  5. `pytest submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/tests -v` (13/13 passing with live Db2)

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python 3.12, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, LangChain, SQLAlchemy, `ibm_db`, Sentence-Transformers, Tailwind CSS
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** LangChain (`langchain-openai`, `langchain-core`)
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** OpenRouter Free (`meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free`) with local deterministic grounded fallback
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** Two-stage hybrid pipeline: semantic similarity over Db2-stored recipe embeddings, followed by Python deterministic re-ranking (coverage, sufficiency, expiry priority), and LangChain grounded recipe instruction formatting with Pydantic validation.

---

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **Live Demo URL (if hosted):** http://localhost:8000
- **External Source Repo (if hosted separately):** https://github.com/ashfinashfi/IBM_Db2_TechX_Project_Submission
- **Submission Branch:** `submission/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer`

---

## 6. Pre-Submission Checklist

- [x] My project folder is inside `submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/`
- [x] Folder name matches `project.slug` exactly
- [x] `submission.json` is complete and valid
- [x] `README.md` and `architecture.md` are present and detailed
- [x] `.env.example` has placeholder keys (no real secrets committed!)
- [x] Source code is inside `submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer/src/`
- [x] Passed local validator: `python scripts/validate_submission.py submissions/db2-recipe-waste-optimizer`
- [x] Solution connects to and executes queries against IBM Db2 in running code
